q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of fishing net per kg?
title: Fishing net carbon footprint per kg
short: Multiply the nylon or HDPE twine per kg of net by the yarn maker's per-kg figure, then add knotting machine electricity, heat setting, dyeing and packing. Divide the unit's energy by kg of netting dispatched.
audience: Fishing net makers in Gujarat, Kerala and Tamil Nadu

ul: Nylon multifilament or HDPE monofilament twine by weight.
Ropes, floats and sinkers if the net is rigged.

p: Report per kg of netting, and separately per rigged net if floats and ropes are included.

example.title: Worked example: fishing net unit per kg (one month)
lines: Plant total: 24,375 / 40,000 = 0.609 kg CO2 per kg
Add twine and rigging for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
